source_id: BW-CMS-01 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Create a valid complaint (Submitted); as Handler perform manual assignment, categorization and Low/Medium/High priority; optionally record one progress update; resolve with resolution details.
expected_result: Complaint accepted as Submitted with an identifier; handling setup and optional progress history recorded without assuming an unspecified transition to In Progress; final outcome Resolved with resolution details.

source_id: BW-CMS-02 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
purpose: Validate Complaint Intake to User-Verified Closure
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Follow complaint intake, handling setup and resolution; where user verification is required, perform successful closure verification as the complainant.
expected_result: Resolved complaint is recorded Closed after successful required complainant verification; closure recorded.

source_id: BW-CMS-03 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
purpose: Validate Complaint Intake to Supervisor-Verified Closure
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Follow complaint intake, handling setup and resolution; where supervisor verification is required, perform successful closure verification as Complaint Supervisor.
expected_result: Resolved complaint is recorded Closed after successful required supervisor verification; closure recorded.

source_id: BW-CMS-04 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Create and set up a complaint; as Complaint Handler reject it while recording rejection details/reason.
expected_result: Complaint moves to Rejected with required reason recorded; do not add a closure transition.

source_id: BW-CMS-05 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Starting from a Closed complaint, submit a dissatisfaction-based reopening request as complainant; as Supervisor deny the request.
expected_result: Request decision recorded as denied and complaint remains Closed.

source_id: BW-CMS-06 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Starting from a Closed complaint, submit a dissatisfaction-based reopening request as complainant; as Supervisor approve the request.
expected_result: Approval decision recorded; complaint marked reopened; exact resulting lifecycle state is not fixed by the specification (ISS-CMS-008).

source_id: BW-CMS-07 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
purpose: Validate Manual Escalation of Unresolved Complaint
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: As Complaint Handler, manually escalate an active unresolved complaint requiring escalation; inspect escalation status.
expected_result: Escalation recorded and complaint tracked as escalated for supervisory monitoring; do not assume closure or resolution.

source_id: BW-CMS-08 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Configure an applicable SLA for an unresolved non-escalated complaint; trigger the SLA-breached system event.
expected_result: System automatically changes escalation status to escalated; use configured SLA values, not invented baseline durations.

source_id: CW-CMS-01 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Test supported intake-to-outcome branches individually: Resolved without forced closure; Resolved then User-verified closure; Resolved then Supervisor-verified closure; Rejected with reason.
expected_result: Each branch has its specified terminal outcome: Resolved, Closed after the applicable successful verification, or Rejected with reason; no invented transitions.

source_id: CW-CMS-02 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Starting from a Closed complaint, request reopening; separately have Supervisor deny and approve reopening requests.
expected_result: Denied branch stays Closed and records decision; approved branch records reopening without assuming an exact unspecified lifecycle state.

source_id: CW-CMS-03 documented workflow path and decision outcomes
preconditions: Required participant identities, valid complaint state and applicable configured guards from the workflow STT.
action_or_input: Independently test manual escalation of an unresolved complaint and automatic escalation after configured SLA breach.
expected_result: Manual and automatic escalations are recorded and made visible for supervisory monitoring under their distinct documented triggers.
